channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Cork Libraries Invite Residents to Get Lost in a Good Book This February
item.description: Cork libraries celebrating Ireland Reads Day on 28th Feb with free author visits, workshops and events countywide. Library membership is free.

item.title: Debris on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of debris, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 6 (N27) Kinsale Road and Junction 7 South Douglas (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 16 February at 13:02.

item.title: ⛴️ Cross River Ferry Suspended
item.description: The Cross River Ferry has been suspended due to refueling. Service expected to resume at 14:00.Source: In Cobh - Cross River Ferry Monitor | 16 February 2026, 13:05

item.title: ⚠️ Yellow Rainfall Warning Issued for Cork
item.description: Met Éireann has issued a Yellow - Rainfall Warning for Cork. Valid: 23:00 Tuesday 17 February until 23:00 Wednesday 18 February, further information will be issued shortly. Further information via met.ie.

item.title: Yellow Rainfall Warning Issued for Cork and Six Other Counties
item.description: Yellow Rainfall Warning for Cork from Tuesday 11pm to Wednesday 11pm. Expect flooding, poor visibility and difficult travelling conditions.

item.title: Apple Urges Users to Update Devices Immediately After Zero-Day Security Flaw Discovered
item.description: Apple releases urgent security updates to fix actively exploited zero-day flaw. Update all devices now via Settings > General > Software Update.

item.title: Pedestrian Knocked Down Bachelors Quay
item.description: Reports a pedestrian has been knocked down on Bachelors Quay near Arc Cinema. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a multi-vehicle collision, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 2 Curraheen and Junction 3 (N71) Bandon Road (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 16 February at 19:06.

item.title: Collision in Kealkill
item.description: Reports of a collision at Chapel Hill Court, Kealkill near Cremin Coaches. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.
